name: Muramite Citadel: Halls
summary: The fortified interior halls connecting the Barracks to deeper Citadel structures.
description: The Halls are the central artery of the Outer Citadel. Massive Discord‑reinforced pillars support vaulted ceilings etched with Muramite war sigils. Legionnaires march in formation, ascenders traverse vertical access points, and Inquisitors maintain arcane wards embedded into the stone. The Halls serve as both ceremonial passage and military conduit, making them one of the most heavily trafficked and guarded areas in the Citadel.
